blocks.text: In software development, front end refers to the presentation layer that users interact with, while back end refers to the data management and processing behind the scenes. "Full stack" refers to both together. In the client–server model, the client is usually considered the front end, handling most user-facing tasks, and the server is the back end, mainly managing data and logic.
Backup-File Format is a data archive format used by the IBM AIX operating system. It stores copies of files in an analogous manner to the Unix tar format.
BFF is a Japanese manga series written and illustrated by Oto Obana. It began serialization on Shogakukan's MangaONE and Ura Sunday websites in August 2024.
